subject.name: Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures
subject.title: CE802 (D) - Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures

modules.title: Engineering Seismology
topics: Introduction to engineering seismology, Geological and tectonic features of India
Origin and propagation of seismic waves, Earthquake measurement parameters
Characteristics of earthquake and its quantification- Magnitude and Intensity scales, Seismic instruments

modules.title: Response Spectrum
topics: Response history and strong motion characteristics
Response Spectrum-elastic and inelastic response spectra, tripartite (D-V-A) response spectrum, use of response spectrum in earthquake resistant design
Computation of seismic forces in multi-storeyed buildings - using procedures as per codal provisions

modules.title: Aseismic Structural Modelling
topics: Structural configuration for earthquake resistant design, Concept of plan irregularities and vertical irregularities, Soft storey, Torsion in buildings
Design provisions for these in IS-1893
Effect of infill masonry walls on frames, modeling concepts of infill masonry walls
Behaviour of masonry buildings during earthquakes, failure patterns, strength of masonry in shear and flexure, Slenderness concept of masonry walls

modules.title: Design of structure for earthquake resistance
topics: Seismic design philosophy, Load combinations, Ductility and energy absorption in buildings
Confinement of concrete for ductility, design of columns and beams for ductility
Ductile detailing provisions as per IS-1893

modules.title: Seismic control of structures
topics: Introduction, concept and types of seismic control systems as active, passive and semi-active systems
Requirements of efficient earthquake resistant structural system, damping devices, base isolation systems
